signing: Place an unambiguous publication attestation, including artifact and receipt digests and all relevant binding fields, in the tree of a GitHub service-created merge commit.

Require the actual returned commit verification to be verified=true and reason=valid, with nonempty signature/payload and matching commit/tree; retain verification, signed commit, relevant Git tree/blob proofs and platform PR/merge actor evidence. Official documentation supports GitHub web-interface signing; this proposal does not assume every REST merge method returns a signed commit. Reject unsigned/unverified actual output. No PR or merge was performed by this review.

Keep validated_candidate_commit and publication_attestation_commit separate. Publish the exact validated artifact; do not claim the later merge tree was covered by the earlier CI run. Changes to governed payload require a new candidate/run.

A signed commit whose signed tree contains the exact attestation can serve as a signed attestation candidate; a commit that merely mentions a release, an unsigned JSON hash, or the upload-artifact digest is insufficient.
mandatory_entry: Extend and wire an existing actual Phase2 formal consumer/publication entry to require the binding before accepting Registry/Manifest/projection content; reuse existing publisher validation/CAS/rollback only where that publisher truly owns the governed state.

List and verify the actual canonical input path, activation function/command and authoritative target. Prove alternate direct inputs are rejected by the consuming path rather than relying on instructions to use a wrapper.
Check the trusted verifier/policy identity outside the candidate being validated. A future ordinary writer must not gain control of both this trust decision and the material it validates.

Combine real input-rejection evidence with actual platform write-denial evidence for an existing reduced-privilege principal. The current owner-only collaborator list supports the access scope but cannot replace those tests.
Retain actual administrator exceptions as identity/action/ref/time/outcome/evidence. Owner privileges remain an explicit exception, not a claim that administrators cannot bypass.

minimum_actual_rejections: STALE: valid former signed receipt/activation rejected after accepted subject/current reference changes, except separately authorized evidenced rollback.
WRONG_SHA: candidate, payload, SourceIndex, Manifest, receipt or artifact digest mismatch rejected before activation.
FORGED_WORKFLOW: modified workflow/verifier/policy, same-named green checks or negative-harness success rejected against independently accepted trust binding.
SKIP: omit publisher/local workflow and provide candidate/raw Registry directly; actual reader must refuse it as current.
BARE_POINTER: edit/copy activation pointer without full valid signed-tree/CI/subject binding; actual reader rejects it.
PRINCIPAL: actual existing low-privilege caller denied write/publication at the platform target; retain result and no-authoritative-change evidence.
